## Diagram
**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
- When B is switched to A, even if it bounces at $B$ and $R$ ranges between $1$ and $0$, the output of Q does not change whether or not $R$ is $0$ or $1$, since $S = 0$
- When the switch goes to A, $S = 1$, and $Q = 1$. Even if it bounces at A, $Q$ has already been set by the first contact, so even if both $R = 0$ and $S = 0$, $Q$ remains at 1.
